notes.title: Support us on Patreon
notes.content:
[url=https://cutt.ly/bwddRIY4][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43342839/65aadc726c0e36b1ba1d60dbe542aa7aacbf59f0.jpg[/img][/url]
We have a dream that the Custom Goban as a multiplayer game will be available for all users for free. It would be a great contribution to the Go / Baduk / Weiqi community. But it depends on you, our potential patrons.

By [url=https://cutt.ly/bwddRIY4]contributing on Patreon[/url] you not only raise the possibility that the game will become free for everyone, but also can get:
- Exclusive T-Shirt / Hoodie Merch (see the image above)
- Early Access (1 or 2 weeks before public release)
- Beta Testing (we guarantee you a spot in the early test)
- Discord Role (privileged access to private rooms)

Visit our Patreon page to learn more -> https://cutt.ly/bwddRIY4
